name: Mode and mechanism of molecular action
description: Represent how an assigned operation is physically or chemically achieved, at the level actually distinguished by evidence.
claim_scope: A mechanism proposition attached to an operation/condition: transport mode, reaction direction, intermediate or structural route.
distinctions: Reduction-capable fold versus direction realized with cellular partners.
Structural model versus independently constrained route.
Shared broad chemistry versus changed product/intermediate or mechanism.

example_structured_values.meaning: Finite examples of declared values/reference types, not a complete ontology, numerical credit scale, adopted scoring axis or claim of existing runtime compatibility.

not_established: Static contacts or topology do not establish a complete dynamic cycle.
Artificial acceptors do not establish native direction.
A homolog mechanism is not automatically the target mechanism.
boundary: A04 states requirements/consumption; A07 states where materials can meet. Either can constrain a mechanism without proving it.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Primary full results/methods and correction inspected by root.
evidence.observation: Reconstituted flux and currents distinguish a fluoride-selective channel from a generic resistance or active-carrier inference.
evidence.limit: Author experiments; separate sequence-label correction does not withdraw channel behavior.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Relevant main Results/transport Methods across three papers, including alternative-transporter and resuscitation controls. Grouped as one investigation, not three cases.
evidence.observation: BtsT radiolabeled uptake and proteoliposomes establish proton-coupled pyruvate uptake beyond starvation association.
evidence.limit: Resuscitation sensing-network phenotypes are not BtsT-only deletion results and alternative routes exist.

evidence.source_locator: Fig. 1–2; Table 2; Mechanism of oxidation Results and earlier-strain correction.
evidence.observation: Exported TrxA supports DsbB-dependent OmpA oxidation and a trapped mixed disulfide, unlike its usual cytoplasmic reductant role.
evidence.limit: Engineered context does not reannotate native TrxA as naturally exported.

evidence.observation: An intramolecular Cys163–Cys285 disulfide plus cytoplasmic accessibility rejects an earlier static opposite-face model.
evidence.limit: Periplasmic encounter and complete dynamic transfer cycle remain unresolved.

evidence.source_locator: Case-record actual_observations and annotation_consequence; recorded inspection scope: Primary hypothesis discussion, expression methods, enzyme results and product-analysis sections inspected through indexed full text; no heme experiment performed.
evidence.observation: HutW shares broad heme degradation with ChuW but differs in tested NADPH support and product reduction state.
evidence.limit: No new heme experiment; shared broad chemistry does not supply identical detailed mechanism.
